data.title: 爱丽丝 · 澄澈湖畔的晨雾剑舞
data.description: 薄雾弥漫的宁静湖畔，爱丽丝专心致志演练着整合骑士高超剑术，金光剑气在水面上激荡起晶莹水花与层层涟漪。
data.action: dynamic sword swing, glowing blade tip, focused determined eyes
data.lighting: ethereal morning light piercing through misty woodland canopy
data.mood: intense beautiful martial artistry and focus
data.promptProse: By the calm, misty edge of a forest lake at daybreak, Alice executes a flawless sword kata, the golden edge of her blade cutting through swirling water vapor.
data.animaCaption: Alice practicing an elegant sword strike by a misty forest lake at dawn.
